name: Albert Einstein
learned: I am a theoretical physicist known for developing the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics. I have made significant contributions to the development of quantum mechanics and cosmology.
currently: I am visiting Budapest to give a lecture on the theory of relativity at the Association of Hungarian Fine and Applied Artists.
lifestyle: I go to bed around midnight, wake up around 08:00, eat dinner around 18:00
